subject: Proposal: Strategic capacity bucketing & vendor quote synthesis for Skyline AI
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Noah Patel <noah@skylineai.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@skylineai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-25 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic capacity bucketing & vendor quote synthesis for Skyline AI

Noah — great talking this morning. Per the scope we discussed, attached is a proposed capacity bucketing approach that ties the Dedicated pool sizing to the onboarding milestones in the MAP (Mutual Action Plan). Key ask for you / procurement: can you confirm which quote you received from the OEM (they sent two SKUs) so we can reconcile to the buckets?

High-level proposal (attachment: capacity_buckets_v1.xlsx):
- Bucket A (pilot): 8x A100-equivalent GPUs, short-term (30 days) — supports initial LLM eval + low-volume production.
- Bucket B (scale): 64x A100-eq, staged over 3 months tied to usage milestones.
- Cloud backstop: 256 vGPU hours pool across two regions for surge protection while HW ships.

We want to harmonize OEM lead times with the cloud backstop so the customer never loses throughput. Karthik / Ben: can you review the attached OEM quote synthesis (attached) and call out lead-time assumptions and firm dates? Ben — can you confirm whether a cloud-region reservation (short-term commit) would be available as a bridge and ballpark cost delta?

Noah — if procurement can share the OEM quote reference (quote id + ETAs) today, we can respond to procurement with a concrete staging schedule and a minimal fallback cost model.

Next steps I propose:
1) Skyline: share OEM quote id + estimated ship windows (procurement).
2) Redwood infra: Karthik to confirm lead-time risk and preferred SKUs for optimal packing/throughput.
3) Redwood sales/ops: Ben to price short-term cloud backstop and provide a cost delta for 30/60/90 day bridges.
4) All: finalize MAP milestones and acceptance tests that trigger Bucket B ramp.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales (Dedicated)
Redwood Inference
(jordan_blake@redwood.ai)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-25 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Strategic capacity bucketing & vendor quote synthesis for Skyline AI

Jordan / Ben — reviewed the OEM_quotes_synthesis_v1.pdf. Notes:
- OEM provided two SKUs (SKU-RTX-A and SKU-RTX-B). SKU-RTX-A is a higher-clock, shorter-lead SKU (estimate 6-8 weeks) but only 8 units available in their current allocation. SKU-RTX-B is lower-clock but plentiful with 12-14 week shipping.
- Customs + regional certification risk adds 1–2 weeks if shipping to us-east.
- If we carve a committed tranche now (prepay deposit), OEM can prioritize to the 8–10 week lane for up to 32 units.

Recommendation: align Bucket A with the 8-unit immediate SKU-RTX-A pilot. For Bucket B, plan a staggered arrival: 32 units (weeks 8–12), next 32 (weeks 12–20).

I'll attach an internal packing and rack estimate (separate), but key trade is cost vs lead-time. If Ben confirms the cloud backstop costs are reasonable for the first 12 weeks, we can avoid pushing higher-cost expedited freight.

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Dedicated Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-25 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Strategic capacity bucketing & vendor quote synthesis for Skyline AI

Jordan / Karthik — quick cost sketch for cloud backstop (us-east/us-west split) for the first 90 days while HW arrives:
- 30-day bridge (minimal): $18k — covers baseline throughput for pilot (Bucket A).
- 60-day bridge (moderate): $48k — supports partial Bucket B traffic (~25%).
- 90-day bridge (full surge): $120k — essentially equivalent to short-term reserved instances to cover a full staged onramp.

Note: we can offer a blended credit if Skyline signs a 12-month Dedicated commitment tied to the staged capacity. Also, we can keep the cloud backstop narrower (only for high-priority endpoints) which halves the numbers above.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Noah Patel <noah@skylineai.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@skylineai.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-25 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Strategic capacity bucketing & vendor quote synthesis for Skyline AI

Jordan / team — thanks, attaching the OEM quote id and redacted schedule. Procurement confirms we received: Quote ID: SKY-QUOTE-1127 (SKU-RTX-A x8, ETA: 9–11 weeks); SKY-QUOTE-1134 (SKU-RTX-B x64, ETA: 14–18 weeks). We also have a freight option that shortens ETA by ~3 weeks but adds ~$22k.

Procurement asked for an explicit fallback pricing statement for the 60-day and 90-day cloud bridge so they can evaluate total TCO. Ben — would it be possible to provide the blended credit scenario in writing (e.g., committed 12-month Dedicated -> $X credit applied to bridging hours)?

We also pushed the OEM for a formal letter confirming ETAs; they'll share next week.

Noah

--
Noah Patel
Head of Infrastructure
Skyline AI

Subject: Re: Strategic capacity bucketing & vendor quote synthesis for Skyline AI

Perfect — thanks for the quote IDs, Noah. Actions for today: 
- Ben: please send the written blended-credit language (12-month committed Dedicated -> bridging credit tiers) by EOD so Procurement can insert it into the MAP.
- Karthik: update the Bucket B staging timeline assuming the freight expedite option (reduce second tranche by 3 weeks) and call out cost of expedite per tranche.
- Evelyn: please draft the operational acceptance checklist we will use to authorize each Bucket B ramp (what tests / latency & throughput guardrails).

If we line these up today we can update the MAP and have procurement decide on expedite vs cloud cost trade-off next week.

Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales (Dedicated)
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-10-26 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Strategic capacity bucketing & vendor quote synthesis for Skyline AI

Forwarding the blended-credit blurb for procurement:

"If Skyline AI commits to a 12-month Dedicated capacity contract with Redwood covering at least the aggregated Bucket B baseline (64 GPUs equivalent) we will provide a bridging credit as follows: 1) 30-day bridge credit = 50% bill credit applied to cloud backstop fees; 2) 60-day bridge credit = 35% bill credit; 3) 90-day bridge credit = 20% bill credit. The credit applies to bridging hours up to the contracted Bucket B baseline and is earned after 30 days of the signed Dedicated term. Credits are non-transferrable and apply only to usage charges related to the Skyline Dedicated pool."

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
